remarks: Start your New Year in a bright & cheerful space! This West-facing apartment in popular Westwood features an open entertainer's flow featuring a designer kitchen with stainless steel appliances, polished hardwood floors in the living/dining area, sun-filled rooms lined with large windows, central air, natural gas heat, excellent closet space and your own personal, in-unit washer & dryer. THERE ARE NO ADDITIONAL FEES! The elegant Westwood community features impeccable maintenance, grounds care and is styled with New England charm! This modern apartment is in a secure mid-rise building with parking, small fitness center and 24-hour security. Pets are Ok, Dogs 35 Lbs. only, 2-Cats Ok or 1-dog and 1-cat OK ($300 fully refundable pet deposit required). Westwood is a No Smoking Community. Please have interested prospects submit the Westwood application uploaded in supplements with a credit check through Applyconnect only.  This apartment is move-in ready! PLEASE NOTE - THIS IS AN APARTMENT IN A SECURE MID-RISE BUILDING, NOT A STAND ALONE TOWNHOME.
